description: Make CubeRanks public ranking and public-list GET responses eligible for Cloudflare caching. The origin remains authoritative: private, no-store, error, and Set-Cookie responses are never stored.
expression: (http.request.method eq "GET" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/rankings" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/rankings/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/regions" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/people/search" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/lists" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/lists/")))
